narrative:
Seneca County has 33,867 registered voters, with 17.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 46.5%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 15.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.9% of registrants.
